results.title: Bills DB Sam Franklin appeals NFL's 1-game suspension, denying he spit at Raiders player
results.description: ORCHARD PARK, N.Y. (AP) — Buffalo Bills defensive back Sam Franklin appealed the NFL's decision to suspend him for one game without pay for allegedly spitting at a Raiders opponent during a game last weekend, the player's agent said on Wednesday.
